messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: HIGH GPU_POOL_SATURATION in prod-gpu-1 (>=95% utilization) — 429s increasing, queue growth observed. Auto-escalation initiated.

sophie: seeing spike of 429s across hotpath routes. Dashboards show queue depth -> 18k requests, avg wait ~4.8s.

miguel: confirmed. Autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts but 'scale_limit_reached' for pool prod-gpu-1. Config max_replicas=8, current=8.

marc-oncall: paging in. I’m on it. Initial assessment: heavy burst from a batch of long-seq requests (chat/prefix=4096). Likely KV cache misses.

liz: customers with reserved capacity (acct: big-ecom) reporting increased latency and 429 spikes. Possible partial fallout across hosted as well.

jay: posting relevant logs: ```
[2024-10-15T14:02:11Z] autoscaler: attempt_scale -> desired=12, max_allowed=8, reason=scale_limit_reached
[2024-10-15T14:02:17Z] pool: enqueue-> qlen=18234
[2024-10-15T14:02:23Z] tokenbucket: drop -> limit=200r/s tier=standard current=520r/s
```

sophie: tokenbucket stats look off. Rate cap per tier seems too strict during surge — causing immediate 429s instead of graceful queueing.

miguel: checked tier config: standard_tier.token_rate=200, burst=400. At sustained 520r/s, we start returning 429s. Should probably fallback to burst or to lower-cost GPUs.

marc-oncall: mitigation options: 1) increase pool max_replicas (fast but requires infra approval), 2) adjust token bucket rates for standard tier (config change), 3) enable graceful fallback to lower-priority model variant (latency tradeoff). Which to prioritize?

liz: customer impact: big-ecom traffics through 'hotpath-prod' routes. Estimated affected sessions ~ 60% of their recent requests. CS is breathing down for ETA.

sophie: short-term: adjust token bucket to allow higher burst and raise sustained rate to 350 for 15m. Medium-term: manually enlarge pool to 12 replicas if infra ok. Long-term: change scaling policy to allow temporary surge above commit for X mins.

jay: infra note: manual scale requires an emergency quota bump but we can hot-add 2 GPUs from spare reservoir in eu-west-1. I can do that in ~6–8 minutes if we authorize.

miguel: quick config patch to tokenbucket ready: ```yaml
tiers:
  standard:
    rate: 350
    burst: 800
    window_ms: 1000
```

marc-oncall: go ahead with tokenbucket change now. Apply as a rolling config to avoid restart. I’ll request the infra hot-add in parallel. Call it mitigation-step-1.

sophie: applying patch to rate-tier in staging->canary->prod. Patching canary now.

incident-bot: Deploy started: tier-config-v2 -> canary (deploy id: dpl-4521). Watch logs.

miguel: canary logs show reduced immediate 429s on canary hosts, queue down from 2k -> 600 within 90s.

marc-oncall: infra team notified for manual scale. Jay please proceed with hot-add if you have the approval.

jay: infra confirmed, starting hot-add of 2 GPUs to prod-gpu-1. ETA ~7m.

liz: FYI CS: telling affected customers we're actively mitigating, ETA 15-30 minutes for stabilization. Keeping them updated.

sophie: canary -> prod rollout starting now (rolling change to tokenbucket). Monitor for any downstream rate spikes or unfair queue starvation.

pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by marc-oncall. Priority: P1. Channel: #incidents.

miguel: note: we also saw autoscaler failing to attach additional instances because of quota tag mismatch. Recorded error: `instance_request: denied - missing billing_tag:dedicated_commit` — need separate followup. But tokenbucket tweak should reduce severity short-term.

marc-oncall: hot-add complete. Pool size now 10/8 -> autoscaler limit still 8 but hot-added nodes bypass limit; verifying node readiness.

jay: new nodes registered and healthy. Promoting traffic. qlen dropping to ~3k, 429 rate down 78%.

sophie: nice. continue to watch. I’ll leave a 15m observation window. If stable, we can roll back tokenbucket to a less permissive setting gradually to avoid cost surprise.

liz: customer update: big-ecom reports errors down to near-normal levels, but some sessions saw degraded throughput. They requested incident summary and action items.

miguel: action items noted: 1) update autoscaler policy to allow temporary surge above max_replicas for emergency (ticket infra#8472), 2) fix quota-tag mapping so autoscaler requests don't get denied, 3) add tokenbucket dynamic tiering to auto-scale rate with pool utilization, 4) postmortem with customer impact.

marc-oncall: logging timeline for postmortem. Immediate next: set retention of this thread and schedule a blameless postmortem in 48h. Assign owners: miguel (autoscale policy), jay (infra quota), sophie (rate-tier tuning + runbook), liz (customer comms).

sophie: quick note for runbook: when GPU pool saturates, prefer tokenbucket transient bump + hot-add if spare capacity exists, rather than full rollback of routing. Add explicit check: if `desired > max_allowed` then attempt hot-reserve and notify infra.

incident-bot: Incident marked as mitigated. Monitoring in watch window (15m).

marc-oncall: Thanks all. I'll stay on watch and escalate if anything flips. If stable at 15m, we close and start postmortem.

miguel: one more: capture a sample of offending requests (ids) and add to eval set to test model-length handling for cost.

liz: copying CS ticket ID 87654 into the incident record.

sophie: closing note: we avoided a long outage by applying rate-tier change + hot-add. Root causes: conservative tokenbucket baseline + autoscaler max_replicas not permitting emergency surge. Postmortem to include timeline and remediation plan. :white_check_mark:
